run_lsc_hitl_node: run the LSC-HITL node to navigate Spot robot using voice instructions and LLM parsing
get_nav_xyt_to_wearer: get navigation x,y,theta coordinates so the robot faces the wearer from a given SE3 pose
get_place_xyz_to_wearer: get fixed xyz coordinates in the robot local frame for placing objects near the wearer
get_handoff_to_human_pose: get the SE3 transform from camera to spotWorld frame for human handoff using tf2 buffer
run_qr_code_detection: run QR code detection on Spot's hand camera and publish the marker transform to spotWorld
